WITH RECURSIVE folder_tree AS ( SELECT * FROM data_template WHERE node_type = 'FOLDER' AND parent_id = 0 AND project_id = #{projectId} AND is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT t.* FROM data_template t INNER JOIN folder_tree ft ON t.parent_id = ft.id WHERE t.node_type = 'FOLDER' AND t.project_id = ft.project_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT * FROM folder_tree

WITH RECURSIVE template_tree AS ( SELECT * FROM data_template WHERE parent_id = 0 AND project_id = #{projectId} AND is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT t.* FROM data_template t INNER JOIN template_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id WHERE t.project_id = tt.project_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT * FROM template_tree

WITH RECURSIVE children AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM data_template WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT t.id, t.parent_id FROM data_template t INNER JOIN children c ON t.parent_id = c.id WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT id FROM children
